'''Pinrado Noza''' was a [[jockey]] who rode [[fathier]]s at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino's]] [[racetrack]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> Noza participated in a [[Fathier racing|fathier race]] on the racetrack<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> shortly before all of the fathier's kept in the casino's stables were released by the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]].<ref name="TLJ" /> The jockey wore a [[Color|blue]] racing outfit including a [[Hat|helmet]] and had fair skin.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pinrado Noza first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
